scripts.build: npm run build --workspace api && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace api" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.dev:applymate: npm run build --workspace @applymate/contracts && concurrently -k -n server,client "npm run dev --workspace @applymate/server" "npm run dev --workspace @applymate/client"
scripts.preview:applymate: concurrently -k -n server,client "npm run start --workspace @applymate/server" "npm run preview --workspace @applymate/client"
scripts.build:applymate: npm run build --workspace @applymate/contracts && npm run build --workspace @applymate/server && npm run build --workspace @applymate/client
scripts.typecheck:applymate: npm run build --workspace @applymate/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @applymate/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @applymate/client && tsc -p applymate/tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:applymate: npm run build --workspace @applymate/contracts && npm test --workspace @applymate/server && npm test --workspace @applymate/client
scripts.check:applymate: npm run typecheck:applymate && npm run lint --workspace @applymate/server && npm run lint --workspace @applymate/client && npm run test:applymate && npm run build:applymate && npm run test:e2e:applymate
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace api && npm run lint --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace api && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run package:api && playwright test
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace api && npm run test:coverage --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace api && npm run typecheck --workspace web && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
